mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT h.province FROM hospital h INNER JOIN hospital_agency_relation r ON h.id = r.hospital_id WHERE h.province IS NOT NULL AND h.province != ''
SELECT DISTINCT h.city FROM hospital h INNER JOIN hospital_agency_relation r ON h.id = r.hospital_id WHERE h.province = #{province} AND h.city IS NOT NULL AND h.city != ''
SELECT DISTINCT h.* FROM hospital h INNER JOIN hospital_agency_relation r ON h.id = r.hospital_id WHERE h.city = #{city}
SELECT DISTINCT province FROM hospital WHERE province IS NOT NULL AND province != '' ORDER BY province
SELECT DISTINCT city FROM hospital WHERE province = #{province} AND city IS NOT NULL AND city != '' ORDER BY city
SELECT id, hospital_name AS hospitalName FROM hospital WHERE city = #{city} ORDER BY hospital_name

SELECT id, province, city, district_county AS districtCounty, hospital_name AS hospitalName, hospital_level AS hospitalLevel FROM hospital WHERE hospital_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY hospital_name
